code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True; q.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            # The figures are solid rectangles; scattered colored marks are noise.
            if area >= 4 and r1 > r0 and c1 > c0 and len(cells)/area >= 0.68:
                for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0,c1+1): out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
